limitations: Candidate changes are in-memory screens only and are not active vehicle, CAD, material, or build selections.

The 0.25/0.4 mm fiberglass skin CAD is slotted to preserve the fin openings. The thermal solver treats any annular barrier as continuous and cannot model that interrupted wall, so no thermal reduction is computed for this skin.

The skin's nominal exact CAD mass is bounded with 1600-1850 kg/m3 assumed density. The added laminate is only a structural/thermal candidate geometry; no shell or fin-root load improvement is calculated.

Nominal geometry does not include adhesive thickness, concentricity, fit tolerance, thermal expansion, vibration movement, material orientation or production process. Physical fit, coupons and instrumented hot tests remain required.
Radially averaged node means do not predict local gradients, fin-slot leakage, end-view-factor bypass, contact hotspots, or 3D heat spreading.
The 45 C plywood/cardboard screen is unchanged; no lower prescribed source temperature or hardware qualification is inferred.
